name: Standoff (MP Maps in Zombies)
author: Liam-McCormack-Github
description:
The Black Ops II multiplayer map Standoff ported into Zombies, with its own scripts and assets and almost no gameplay changes. It ships its own images, so no DLC is needed. Special enemies, including the DLC 5 ports, appear on every map.

Installs the MP Maps in Zombies Menu, which adds a main menu button to launch it. From the console, with any mod loaded: g_gametype zstandard;map zm_village

This is an early beta. Bug reports: [url=https://github.com/Liam-McCormack-Github/bo2-release-builds]github.com/Liam-McCormack-Github/bo2-release-builds[/url]
